segments.en: Hello.
Hello.
Hello.
Where are you from?
I am from Mumbai, and where are you from?
I am also from Mumbai.
Where in Mumbai do you live?
I am in Thane.
Okay, I live in Vashi.
Okay, can I be your ATM?
What can you be?
ATM.
ATM?
Yes.
Sorry, how does that work? I am hearing this for the first time.
Actually, we... I mean, we will always, whenever you need anything...
or need to do some shopping, we will do it for you.
What will you do?
Whenever you need to do some shopping, we will do the shopping for you.
Oh, so in return, what benefit do you get?
I just want to talk to you on WhatsApp, that's it.
Thank you so much, but I am sorry, I can't accept it because I am a one-time user and I am in the medical field.
What, what?
What do you do for a living?
I have my own shop.
What kind of shop do you have?
A food and drink shop.
Food and drink shop? Okay, by the way, thank you so much for your opportunity, but I am sorry, I earn 2 lakhs, so I know how to do my own shopping.
If you earn 2 lakhs, then why are you here? Tell me.
I am actually confused about whether I should get married or not.
My parents are forcing me to get married, and I have no interest in marriage, so I wanted to know...
I just need one friend, that's it.
If you are a friend, then I can be your friend, no doubt.
So we will do everything for you, that's it.
Don't do anything, just talk to me and give me advice.
Okay, but what kind of...
Sorry, your voice is breaking.
I said, can I give you my number?
No thanks, I won't call you.
Okay, no problem.
Are you married or unmarried?
I am unmarried.
Okay, tell me more about yourself.
That's it, I just wanted to say that, nothing else.
Okay, don't say that to anyone, otherwise anyone will take you as an ATM and go shopping.
So it will work, right? What do I care? I just need a friend, that's it.
That's wrong. If you have a friend, be a friend, but don't be anyone's ATM.
Because I want to, and I get happiness from it, so what?
You get happiness, but they will ruin you and leave you. That's how the world is nowadays.
I don't care about all that.
Ah, so it turns out you will roam with them, and for money, you will roam with someone else. So what's the point?
I don't care about that. I just need a partner, that's it. Whatever happens, I don't care.
Do you need a partner or a friend?
A friend and a partner are the same thing, oh man.
No, no, no, no, both are different.
A partner is for a lifetime. A friend is limited to being a friend. A partner is someone who walks through life with us. That is a partner, a life partner.
Yes, so I just need that, nothing else.
If you want a life partner, then don't look for it here. I can tell you clearly.
Okay, okay.
Okay.
No problem.
Yes, and don't do this money thing.
